entries.msgstr: Conceptualization of a draft design developed at the request of General Francesco Rossi who believed that only light vehicles weighing up to 35 tons would be effective in a new war. Such an innovative design was not approved; development was discontinued when Italy joined the Standard Tank project.

A draft of a heavy tank developed by cadet Tadeusz Tyszkiewicz at the Military Technical Academy of Warsaw in the early 1950s. The new vehicle was supposed to weigh up to 50 tons. Existed only in blueprints.
